narrative.intro: Thalle Construction obligated $1.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction received 3 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $640M. Obligations were up 572.6% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows that Thalle Construction recorded obligations of $167M in FY21, $213M in FY22, $16.1M in FY23, $366M in FY24, and $285M in FY25, before the current-year total of $1.9B. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, accounting for $1.9B of obligations in FY2026 to date. Other buying activity includes the Department of the Interior at $239K. The company’s work in NAICS markets is concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.9B, with a smaller presence in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction at $239K. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This snapshot highlights a concentrated buyer and market profile, large average award size so far, and a sharp year-over-year increase in obligations for the current fiscal year.
